scope: Product specification guidance shared by 240 products in English and Chinese
buyer_problem: Buyers cannot translate a design selection into an unambiguous quotation brief.
changes: Separate product envelope from usable internal and finished external dimensions
Different material parameters for rigid, carton, corrugated and bag families
Record insert support/access or bag loaded carrying requirements
Define artwork approval and quantity/delivery inputs without invented values
claim_basis: Project-dependent specification requests, not measured SKU specifications or completed test claims.

source.supports: Paperboard thickness/grammage relationships vary; creasing depends on chosen board and thickness. No source numerical limits copied into product claims.

score_note: Editorial judgment, not a measured search performance result.
review: Existing product identity, artwork, related links, enquiry prefills, schema and URLs preserved; only quotation guidance changed.
limitations: No new measured dimensions, tolerances, MOQ, prices, lead times or load ratings supplied by this update.
Review is shared buying guidance, not a complete individual technical specification audit of 240 SKUs.
